opcache-memory.description: PSRAM in KB for OPcache's bytecode cache, taken from PHP's memory_limit (plus about 64 KB OPcache allocates besides it); no JIT, nothing is written to flash. Needs a board with 4 MB of PSRAM or more: below that OPcache is disabled at boot.

opcache-validate.description: microsd storage: check the scripts' timestamps (opcache.validate_timestamps), for PHP files the program itself writes on the card. Off: the sources change only with a flash or a sync, which restart the board. Always off with embedded storage. FAT stores modification times with 2-second resolution, and without a set clock every file gets the same 1980 time: a file rewritten within 2 seconds, or while the clock is unset, may not be detected.

cost: about 280 KB, and opcache-memory KB of PSRAM taken from memory_limit
